_what: How each MACULA phrase rule is read by the clean builder (stage S1). Data, not code (docs/BUILDER-DESIGN.md). Each rule is one KIND: coord (every conjunct is a member of a composite), head_first / head_last (the head, with the other children as its dependents under the named relation), prep (a preposition and its object: the object is the filler, the preposition goes on the edge), wrap (one child, transparent). A rule not listed: MACULA's explicit head mark if it has one, else the first child. Surveyed 2026-09-27: 210 phrase rules; the ones below cover the great majority of groups.
_null: A null relation (the article, the object marker) makes no edge: the word is structural, and its morpheme is claimed by the head it marks.
